# S2: labelled fallback ablation (generated by scripts/fsn_s2_report.py)

Images: 229 single-item test images (3/class, seed 0) from 92 of 123 classes. Accuracy % with 95% bootstrap CI (2000 resamples over images). Match = exact/plural/space-less/synonym; no word-subset matches.
`*_resolved` = VLM name additionally accepted if its knowledge-layer canonical food matches. `hybrid` = YOLO if conf >= threshold, else Qwen (hinted with YOLO class unless suppressed). `yolo_abstain` = pre-LLM behaviour (below threshold = unknown).
